calculated_numerical_findings: Combined load/vibration dominates the retained design: 60 of 119 recordings (50.4 percent), compared with 26 static and 9 unloaded-vibration runs. No additional sensor cleaning is performed.

analysis_method: Every candidate is audited independently. FFT uses base MATLAB; optional Welch PSD and spectrogram functions are unavailable.
calculated_numerical_findings: The audit now distinguishes data eligibility from software availability: 90 candidates fail timing and 1 passes for base-MATLAB FFT. The earlier rejection of the valid interval was an unnecessarily restrictive toolbox gate, not a defect in its timestamps. A directly evaluated periodic Hann window and built-in fft recover that result without changing the continuity thresholds. Welch PSD and spectrograms remain omitted because their toolbox functions are not installed; unavailable software is not used to excuse invalid timing elsewhere.
limitations_or_warnings: No FFT, PSD, spectrogram or dominant-frequency claim is made for rejected intervals. PWM is never converted to Hz. All retained source QC statuses are carried into run_metrics.csv. Existing cleaning included spike filtering and short-gap interpolation; original peaks cannot be recovered. No additional sensor cleaning is performed.
